operations.name: Agent
operations.description: Agent structural declaration (memory, beliefs, goals, capabilities)
operations.long_description: Declares an agent's identity and initial AAM state. Every graph must have exactly one AGENT node. It configures memory tiers (STM/LTM/Episodic), initial beliefs and goals, and the capabilities the agent can invoke. The runtime uses this to initialize the agent's AAM before executing any other node.

fields.name: memory
fields.description: Memory configuration

fields.name: beliefs
fields.description: Initial beliefs

fields.name: goals
fields.description: Initial goals

fields.name: capabilities
fields.description: Available capabilities

operations.name: QueryMemory
operations.description: Retrieve data from memory (STM, LTM, or Episodic)
operations.long_description: Reads from the agent's memory system. Supports three tiers: STM (short-term, per-execution scratch), LTM (long-term, persists across runs), and Episodic (execution traces). The query string is matched against stored keys. Returns the stored value or null if not found.

fields.name: query
fields.description: Query string or key to search for

fields.name: memory_tier
fields.description: Target memory tier: stm, ltm, or episodic

operations.name: UpdateMemory
operations.description: Persist or update data in memory
operations.long_description: Writes a key-value pair to the agent's memory system. If the key already exists, the value is overwritten. Supports the same three memory tiers as QMEM. Use FENCE after UMEM if subsequent QMEM nodes must see the write.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Key to store the value under

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value to store

fields.name: memory_tier
fields.description: Target memory tier: stm, ltm, or episodic

operations.name: Ask
operations.description: Simple Q&A with LLM (no extended thinking)
operations.long_description: Sends a prompt to the configured LLM and returns the response. The lightest LLM operation — no chain-of-thought or extended thinking. Use for straightforward questions, classifications, extractions, or reformulations. Template strings support named `{input}` interpolation for dataflow inputs via the node's `input_names` array.

fields.name: template_str
fields.description: Prompt template for the question

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: Sampling temperature (0.0-1.0)

fields.name: model
fields.description: LLM model override (uses config default)

operations.name: Think
operations.description: Extended thinking with token_budget
operations.long_description: Activates extended thinking (chain-of-thought) with a configurable token budget. The LLM produces internal reasoning before the final answer. Use for complex multi-step problems, math, code generation, or planning that benefits from deliberate reasoning. The budget controls how many tokens the model can spend thinking.

fields.name: template_str
fields.description: Prompt template for deep reasoning

fields.name: budget
fields.description: Token budget for extended thinking

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: Sampling temperature (0.0-1.0)

fields.name: model
fields.description: LLM model override (uses config default)

operations.name: Reason
operations.description: Structured reasoning with belief/goal updates
operations.long_description: Performs structured reasoning that can update the agent's beliefs and goals (AAM state). Unlike ASK, the runtime parses the LLM response for belief and goal mutations. Use when the agent needs to update its internal state based on new information. Supports structured JSON output mode.

fields.name: template_str
fields.description: Prompt template for structured reasoning

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: Sampling temperature (0.0-1.0)

fields.name: model
fields.description: LLM model override (uses config default)

fields.name: structured
fields.description: Enable structured JSON output

operations.name: Plan
operations.description: Decompose goal into AIS subgraph
operations.long_description: Uses the LLM to decompose a high-level goal into a sequence of concrete steps. The output is a structured plan that can be used to drive subsequent nodes. Supports optional constraints to bound the plan space.

fields.name: goal
fields.description: Goal to decompose into steps

fields.name: constraints
fields.description: Constraints on the plan

operations.example_json: {"id": 1, "op": "PLAN", "attributes": {"goal": "Research and summarize recent AI papers", "constraints": "max 5 steps"}}

operations.name: Reflect
operations.description: Analyze execution trace for self-improvement
operations.long_description: Retrieves past execution traces and asks the LLM to analyze them for patterns, failures, or improvements. Useful for iterative refinement loops where the agent learns from its own execution history.

fields.name: trace_query
fields.description: Query to retrieve trace for reflection

fields.name: reflection_prompt
fields.description: Custom prompt for reflection

operations.name: Verify
operations.description: Fact-check outputs against evidence
operations.long_description: Cross-references a claim against provided evidence using the LLM. Returns a verification result with confidence score. Use after ASK/THINK/REASON nodes to validate outputs before acting on them. Evidence may be supplied either as a literal attribute or via an incoming Data edge.

fields.name: claim
fields.description: Claim to verify

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: Evidence to check against

operations.name: InvokeTool
operations.description: Call external tool with structured params; store result
operations.long_description: Invokes a registered capability (tool or function) by name. The capability must be declared in the AGENT node's capabilities list or registered in the runtime's CapabilityRegistry. Parameters are passed via the `params_json` attribute as a JSON object. The tool's return value becomes this node's output token.

fields.name: capability
fields.description: Name of the capability/tool to invoke

fields.name: params_json
fields.description: JSON-encoded parameters to pass to the tool

operations.name: ExecuteCode
operations.description: Run code in a sandboxed environment; update Beliefs
operations.long_description: Executes arbitrary code in a sandboxed environment. The sandbox prevents file system access, network calls, and other side effects unless explicitly allowed. The code's stdout/return value becomes the output token. Execution results are also written to the agent's beliefs.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Code to execute

fields.name: sandbox_config
fields.description: Sandbox configuration

operations.name: PrintOutput
operations.description: Print output to stdout for debugging or user display
operations.long_description: Writes a message to stdout. Supports named `{input}` template interpolation via `input_names`. Useful for debugging graphs during development or displaying final results to the user. The message is also stored as the output token.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Message to print

operations.name: Jump
operations.description: Unconditional jump to a labeled instruction
operations.long_description: Transfers control flow unconditionally to a target label. The label must correspond to a node ID in the graph. Edges from this node use Control dependency type.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Target label to jump to

operations.name: BranchOnValue
operations.description: Conditional branch based on token value comparison
operations.long_description: Evaluates an input token against a value and branches to one of two labels. If the token matches the value, control goes to label_true; otherwise to label_false. Used for if/else patterns in agent workflows.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value to compare against

fields.name: true_label
fields.description: Label if comparison is true

fields.name: false_label
fields.description: Label if comparison is false

operations.name: LoopStart
operations.description: Begin bounded loop
operations.long_description: Marks the beginning of a bounded loop. The count_token specifies how many iterations to execute. Must be paired with a LOOP_END node. The compiler verifies loop bounds at compile time to prevent infinite loops.

fields.name: count_token
fields.description: Token containing iteration count

operations.name: LoopEnd
operations.description: End bounded loop
operations.long_description: Marks the end of a bounded loop started by LOOP_START. The runtime decrements the loop counter and branches back to LOOP_START if iterations remain.

operations.name: Return
operations.description: Return from subgraph with result token
operations.long_description: Returns a value from a subgraph or flow. The result value is provided via an incoming Data edge.

operations.name: Switch
operations.description: Multi-way branch based on string value comparison
operations.long_description: Routes execution to one of several branches based on matching a discriminant token against case labels. Each case specifies a label string and a destination node. If no case matches, the default destination is used. The matched branch's result becomes the output token.

fields.name: discriminant
fields.description: Token to match against case labels

fields.name: cases
fields.description: Array of case label/destination pairs

fields.name: default
fields.description: Default destination if no case matches

operations.name: FlowCall
operations.description: Call a flow on another agent with implicit parallelism
operations.long_description: Invokes a named flow on a target agent. The target agent executes its flow graph independently and returns the result. Multiple FLOW_CALL nodes can execute in parallel if they have no data dependencies between them. This is the primary mechanism for multi-agent composition.

fields.name: agent_name
fields.description: Name of the agent to call

fields.name: flow_name
fields.description: Name of the flow to invoke

fields.name: args
fields.description: Arguments to pass to the flow

operations.name: WorkflowSpawn
operations.description: Spawn an external AIR file, artifact, or workflow as a child execution
operations.long_description: Invokes an external AIR file, precompiled artifact, or workflow file as a child execution boundary. Arguments are passed by name through the args map. The child run resolves its session root from the explicit node attribute when present, otherwise it inherits the parent execution root.

fields.name: target_kind
fields.description: Invocation target kind: air_path, artifact_path, or workflow_path

fields.name: target
fields.description: Path of the AIR file, artifact, or workflow to execute

fields.name: args
fields.description: Arguments to pass to the child execution

fields.name: session_root
fields.description: Explicit session root for the child execution

fields.name: await_result
fields.description: Whether to wait for the child result (must be true in the current runtime)

operations.name: CallSkill
operations.description: Call another skill by manifest identity (id or id@version)
operations.long_description: Invokes another skill resolved by manifest identity through the live SkillLibrary, rather than by raw artifact path. Resolution is lazy: the runtime parses `<skill_id>[@<version>]`, looks up the matching .apxmobj, admits the child's required capabilities against the parent's grant, dispatches the child entry DAG, and records the resolved (skill_id, version, artifact_hash) triple in the parent's provenance. Failure modes are typed: InvalidSkillId, SkillNotFound, SkillVersionNotFound, CapabilityWiden, CallSkillDepthExceeded, ChildExecutionFailed.

fields.name: skill_id
fields.description: Skill identifier: "id" (latest) or "id@version" (pinned)

fields.name: args
fields.description: Positional arguments forwarded to the child's entry-flow input vector

fields.name: input_names
fields.description: Optional name vector mapping parent outputs onto the child's positional args

operations.name: Merge
operations.description: Sync parallel paths; aggregate tokens into one
operations.long_description: Waits for multiple parallel branches to complete and combines their output tokens into a single aggregated result. Inputs are provided via incoming Data edges.

operations.name: Fence
operations.description: Memory barrier; order prior QMEM/UMEM operations
operations.long_description: Ensures all preceding memory operations (UMEM writes) are visible to subsequent QMEM reads. Without a FENCE, the scheduler may reorder memory operations for parallelism. Place between UMEM and QMEM when ordering matters.

fields.name: ordering
fields.description: Memory ordering constraint

operations.name: WaitAll
operations.description: Block until all specified tokens are available
operations.long_description: Blocks execution until all listed input tokens are ready. Unlike MERGE, it does not combine the tokens — it simply acts as a synchronization barrier. Inputs are provided via incoming Data edges.

operations.name: TryCatch
operations.description: Structured exception handling with recovery subgraph
operations.long_description: Wraps a try subgraph with a catch recovery subgraph. If any node in the try subgraph fails, execution transfers to the catch subgraph. The catch subgraph receives the error context and can attempt recovery or graceful degradation.

fields.name: try_label
fields.description: Subgraph to try executing

fields.name: catch_label
fields.description: Recovery subgraph on failure

operations.name: HandleError
operations.description: Invoke recovery template on failure; update Goals/Beliefs
operations.long_description: Handles an error by invoking a recovery template. The error handler can update the agent's goals and beliefs to reflect the failure and adapt the agent's strategy. Typically used inside TRY_CATCH catch subgraphs.

fields.name: recovery_template
fields.description: Error handler / recovery template to invoke

operations.name: Communicate
operations.description: Send message to recipient agent via selected protocol
operations.long_description: Sends a message from this agent to another agent. The message is received via input tokens from upstream edges. Supports four protocol dispatch modes: 'local' (default, in-process sub-flow), 'http'/'https' (external APXM agent), 'acp' (ACP subprocess via ProcessTable), and 'broadcast' (fan-out to all agents). The recipient attribute key is 'recipient'.

fields.name: recipient
fields.description: Target agent name (or URL for http protocol)

fields.name: message
fields.description: Message content to send

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Dispatch protocol: local (default), http, https, acp, broadcast

fields.name: llm_operation
fields.description: Semantic LLM operation for analysis when this communication sends an agent prompt

operations.name: Handoff
operations.description: Hand off execution from one agent to another with optional state transfer
operations.long_description: Transfers execution control from a source agent to a target agent. When transfer_state is true, the source agent's context-stack frames are copied to the target agent so it can continue with full conversational context. Emits HANDOFF_START and HANDOFF_END events with span continuity for tracing. The target agent's response becomes this node's output token.

fields.name: handoff_from
fields.description: Source agent name

fields.name: handoff_to
fields.description: Target agent name

fields.name: payload
fields.description: Message payload to pass to the target agent

fields.name: transfer_state
fields.description: Whether to copy context-stack frames from source to target (default: true)

operations.name: UpdateGoal
operations.description: Modify AAM goals at runtime: set, remove, or clear
operations.long_description: Dynamically modifies the agent's goal set during execution. Supports three actions: 'set' (upsert a goal with priority), 'remove' (delete a specific goal), and 'clear' (remove all goals). Goal changes are visible to subsequent REASON and REFLECT nodes.

fields.name: goal_id
fields.description: Goal identifier (used as description key for upsert/remove)

fields.name: action
fields.description: Action to perform: set (default), remove, clear

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Goal priority (u32, default: 1)

operations.name: Pause
operations.description: Suspend execution pending human-in-the-loop review via checkpoint
operations.long_description: Creates a checkpoint and suspends execution until a human resumes it via the APXM server API. The pause message is displayed to the human reviewer. Optionally sends a webhook notification. The human can provide input that becomes this node's output token when RESUME is called.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Human-readable message explaining the pause

fields.name: checkpoint_id
fields.description: Stable checkpoint ID (auto-generated if omitted)

fields.name: timeout_ms
fields.description: Max wait in ms (0 = indefinite, default: 0)

fields.name: poll_interval_ms
fields.description: Polling interval in ms (default: 2000)

fields.name: notification_url
fields.description: Webhook URL to notify on pause creation

fields.name: server_url
fields.description: Override APXM_SERVER_URL env var

operations.name: Resume
operations.description: Resume a suspended PAUSE checkpoint; polls server until human resumes; returns human_input
operations.long_description: Polls the APXM server for a specific checkpoint until a human resumes it. When resumed, the human's input (if any) becomes this node's output token. Configurable polling interval and max attempts prevent indefinite blocking.

fields.name: checkpoint
fields.description: Checkpoint ID to resume from

fields.name: poll_max_attempts
fields.description: Max polling attempts (default 60 × 5s = 5 min)

fields.name: poll_interval_ms
fields.description: Interval between polls in ms (default 5000)

fields.name: server_url
fields.description: Override APXM_SERVER_URL env var

operations.name: Delegate
operations.description: Delegate a task to a sub-agent for execution
operations.long_description: Creates a sub-task from a task specification and assigns it to a target agent. Returns a task handle that can be used to track the delegated work. The target agent executes the task independently and reports results back.

fields.name: task_spec
fields.description: Description of the task to delegate

fields.name: target_agent
fields.description: Name of the agent to delegate to

operations.name: Nop
operations.description: No-op passthrough with no side effects or AAM transition
operations.long_description: Pure passthrough operation with no side effects and no AAM state transition. Passes through its first input unchanged, or returns Null if no inputs. Useful as a placeholder, sync point, or structural node in graph composition.

operations.name: Identity
operations.description: Identity passthrough that records an AAM identity transition
operations.long_description: Like NOP but produces an AAM identity transition (state unchanged but recorded in the execution trace). Useful for observability when you want to mark a point in the graph without changing state.

operations.name: SpawnAgent
operations.description: Create a new agent instance at runtime, optionally as an ACP subprocess
operations.long_description: Spawns a new agent instance. Without profile or agent_route, registers a local process for flow-based agents. With profile, spawns that ACP profile. With agent_route='auto', APXM selects an ACP profile from host-supplied route candidates using required_capabilities and preferred_profiles. The agent can then receive COMMUNICATE (protocol 'acp' or 'local') or DELEGATE messages. Returns the agent's identifier and metadata.

fields.name: agent_name
fields.description: Name for the new agent

fields.name: profile
fields.description: APXM ACP agent profile. When present, spawns an ACP subprocess

fields.name: agent_route
fields.description: Set to 'auto' to let APXM select an ACP profile when profile is omitted

fields.name: required_capabilities
fields.description: Abstract route capabilities required from the selected ACP profile

fields.name: preferred_profiles
fields.description: Preferred APXM ACP profiles used as a tie-breaker after capability fit

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Agent mode to set after spawn (e.g. 'architect', 'code')

fields.name: model
fields.description: Agent-specific model hint accepted by the selected ACP profile

fields.name: cwd
fields.description: Working directory for the agent subprocess (defaults to current dir)

fields.name: capabilities
fields.description: List of capabilities for the new agent

fields.name: goals
fields.description: Initial goals for the new agent

fields.name: system_prompt
fields.description: System prompt / instructions for inline agents — enables HANDOFF/COMMUNICATE dispatch without registering the agent as a separate compiled flow

operations.name: RegisterCapability
operations.description: Register a new capability (tool) in the runtime registry
operations.long_description: Dynamically registers a new capability in the runtime's capability registry. The capability becomes available for INV_CAP operations after registration. Returns a confirmation with the registered capability name.

fields.name: capability_name
fields.description: Name for the capability to register

fields.name: description
fields.description: Human-readable description of the capability

fields.name: parameters_schema
fields.description: JSON schema for capability parameters

fields.name: python_handler_id
fields.description: Stable content-addressed id (sha256:<hex64>) for a Python-backed tool handler

operations.name: RegisterHook
operations.description: Register an author lifecycle hook into the artifact hook registry
operations.long_description: Registers one author lifecycle hook (a Python handler bound to a lifecycle event) into the per-artifact hook registry. The binding travels inside the artifact (AIR-portable) and the handler is dispatched via the same Python tool bridge as @tool. The runtime applies pre/post_cap hooks at the tool dispatch sites, pre/post_ask as Ask middleware, and session_start as an awaited pre-step.

fields.name: hook_event
fields.description: Lifecycle event the hook binds to

fields.name: hook_match
fields.description: Glob over tool/op name the hook applies to (default *)

fields.name: hook_mode
fields.description: Hook mode: observe or gate

fields.name: python_hook_handler_id
fields.description: Stable content-addressed id (sha256:<hex64>) for the Python hook handler

operations.name: Autonomous
operations.description: Run a goal-directed autonomous loop with the configured model
operations.long_description: Runs an iterative plan / act / evaluate loop against a goal prompt. The node keeps calling the configured model until the goal is achieved or `max_iterations` is reached. Optional backend, model, system prompt, provider, and temperature attributes follow the same routing contract as the other LLM operations.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Goal or objective for the autonomous loop

fields.name: max_iterations
fields.description: Maximum number of plan / act / evaluate iterations before stopping

fields.name: backend
fields.description: Backend override for the autonomous loop

fields.name: model
fields.description: Model override for the autonomous loop

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Provider override when backend routing is not used

fields.name: system_prompt
fields.description: System prompt applied to each model call in the loop

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: Sampling temperature for the loop's model calls

operations.example_json: {"id": 3, "op": "AUTONOMOUS", "attributes": {"prompt": "Find the root cause and propose a fix", "max_iterations": 6}}

operations.name: Checkpoint
operations.description: Create a durable execution checkpoint and emit a manifest token
operations.long_description: Serializes execution state at a barrier point and persists it under a stable checkpoint identifier. The snapshot captures AAM state plus runtime checkpoint metadata, and emits a manifest token containing the checkpoint id, timestamp, and byte size so downstream nodes can reference the saved state. Execution continues immediately after the snapshot — this is NOT a suspend point (use PAUSE when you need human-gated suspension).

fields.name: checkpoint_id
fields.description: Stable identifier for this checkpoint

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Snapshot scope: full (default) or local

fields.name: storage
fields.description: Storage backend: fs (default), memory, or custom

fields.name: ttl_seconds
fields.description: Time-to-live for the checkpoint in seconds

fields.name: on_fail
fields.description: Failure mode: halt (default) or continue

operations.name: ConstStr
operations.description: String constant (compiler internal for string literals)
operations.long_description: Compiler-internal operation that produces a constant string value. Not available in the public AIS. The compiler generates CONST_STR nodes when lowering template strings to explicit dataflow.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The string constant value

operations.name: Yield
operations.description: Yield value from switch case region (terminates region)
operations.long_description: Compiler-internal operation that terminates a switch case region and yields a value to the parent SWITCH node. Not available in the public AIS.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The value to yield from the region
